yard_intro_narrator.speaker: NARRATOR
yard_intro_narrator.dialogue: A freezing sea-breeze drifts through the chain-link fence. Snow gathers in the tire ruts behind the Whirling-in-Rags. The air smells of cheap motor oil and industrial grease.

yard_kim_comment.speaker: KIM KITSURAGI
yard_kim_comment.dialogue:
The Lieutenant adjusts the collar of his orange bomber jacket and glances toward the fence.

"Looks like fresh tire tracks, officer. Someone pulled an heavy vehicle in here within the last twelve hours."

yard_perception_check.speaker: PERCEPTION (SIGHT)
yard_perception_check.dialogue: Deep tread patterns cut into the slush. Heavy treads — an eight-wheeled FALN 'Kugel' transport, or something modified with off-road chains.

options.label: "Let's take a plaster cast of those treads before the snow covers them."
Grip your Horrific Necktie and whisper: 'What do you make of this, bratan?'
"Tires, snow, misery. Just another Tuesday in Revachol West."

branch_tracks_kim.speaker: KIM KITSURAGI
branch_tracks_kim.dialogue: He nods once, reaching into his pocket for a notebook and a ballpoint pen. "Good instinct. We don't have plaster, but I can sketch the tread profile for the RCM database."

branch_tracks_interfacing.speaker: INTERFACING
branch_tracks_interfacing.dialogue: The symmetry in his sketch is pristine. You can almost feel the cold steel gear-shifter of the mystery vehicle in your palms. It was accelerating fast when it left.

branch_necktie_speaks.speaker: HORRIFIC NECKTIE
branch_necktie_speaks.dialogue: 'Bratan!' the garish polyester pattern seems to writhe around your throat. 'The tracks are a distraction! The real action is inside the dumpster! Beautiful, fermented alcohol bottles waiting to be reclaimed!'

branch_necktie_inland.speaker: INLAND EMPIRE
branch_necktie_inland.dialogue: He isn't wrong. A strange psychic aura radiates from behind the steel recycling bin. A dark, vibrating hum.

branch_necktie_volition.speaker: VOLITION
branch_necktie_volition.dialogue: Stop talking to your clothing in front of your junior officer. He is literally watching your mouth twitch.

options.label: [Clear your throat] "Just thinking out loud, Kim."

branch_shrug_narrator.speaker: NARRATOR
branch_shrug_narrator.dialogue: The cold seeps deep into your boots. Revachol does not care about your fatigue, but for a moment, the world is quiet.

options.label: [Step back into the warmth of the hostel]

node_conclusion.speaker: NARRATOR
node_conclusion.dialogue: The investigation in the yard concludes. The snow continues to fall in steady, silent flakes.
